annotations.description: Puresteel Paladin with Metalcraft already active (3 artifacts: Mox Opal, Shadowspear, Colossus Hammer) would enable equipping Colossus Hammer for {0}, the deck's primary game plan. Stoneforge Mystic searches for more equipment when the hand/board is already loaded with equipment.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Stoneforge Mystic to search for another equipment card
annotations.betterLine: Cast Puresteel Paladin (WW via Sacred Foundry + Mox Opal) to enable free Colossus Hammer equips with Metalcraft, which is the deck's core combo. Could then equip Colossus Hammer next turn for free to any creature.

annotations.description: Searched for Leyline Axe when they already had one in hand. Paradise Mantle (0-cost equipment) was available and would have been much better - it's free to cast, triggers Puresteel Paladin draws, contributes to Metalcraft, and provides mana. The existing Leyline Axe in hand can be cheated into play via Stoneforge Mystic's activated ability.
annotations.actionTaken: Searched for a second copy of Leyline Axe via Stoneforge Mystic ETB
annotations.betterLine: Search for Paradise Mantle - a free equipment that synergizes with Puresteel Paladin's draw trigger and Metalcraft, while using Stoneforge's activated ability to deploy the Leyline Axe already in hand

annotations.description: At 5 life facing 5 total damage from three attackers (Ragavan 2/1, Guide of Souls ~1/1, Seasoned Pyromancer 2/2) with Goblin Bombardment on the opponent's side, only blocking with one creature leaves more unblocked damage than necessary. Blocking with both Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin on two different attackers would prevent more damage and improve survival chances.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked with only Puresteel Paladin, leaving Stoneforge Mystic as a non-blocker despite being at exactly lethal damage.
annotations.betterLine: Block with both Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic on separate attackers to prevent as much combat damage as possible when at 5 life facing 5 damage.
